system.description:
Anubis' Blessing: while you wear it, enemies have Major Disadvantage on Attack Actions that target you. From the sample adventure Corporate Risers.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.213
system.summary: Anubis' Blessing: while you wear it, enemies have Major Disadvantage on Attack Actions that target you. From the sample adventure Corporate Risers.

automation.note: Anubis' Blessing (while worn): any enemy making an Attack Action against you has Major Disadvantage (-1 Talent Die, or -2 Skill Dice if it has no Talent Dice; minimum 1 die). The Director applies it.
